arabic text: Abad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: Karbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Zainab ko narasaya muharram ka mahina\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: The month of Muharram did not suit Zainab\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Ek din tha, ke is-e shehr-e ki karti thi me shahi Or aaj-e tabahi Be ghusl-e para mor-e\nnabuwat-e ka nagina. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: Once I ruled with honour in this city—but today there is only ruin The jewel of\nProphethood lies unwashed. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Kis laash-e pe rowu kis chor-u me baraa dar Lash-e he bahat tar Had ye he ke rone ki\nijazat-e bhi mili na. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: Upon which body should I weep, and which brother should I leave? There are countless bodies The limit is that\nI was not even permitted to cry. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Asghar ka gala bhayi ka sar, sinaye akbar Sab goharo chadar Is dasht-e me luta gaya\nzainab-e ka khazina. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: Asghar's throat, my brother's head, Akbar's chest—every jewel and every veil In this desert,\nZainab's entire treasure was plundered. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Maye binaa pehchan-e saki, bacho ke chehre Bikhre huwe sehre Hai khun-e ke darya\nme gharibo ka safian. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: Mothers cannot recognise the faces of their children—the wedding crowns lie scattered The boat of the helpless\nis drowning in a river of blood. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Ek aag-e hai, khaymo me kayamat-e ka samaa hai Ghazi tu kaha hai Dekho to ridaa\nchin-e liya, shimr-e kamina. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: The tents are ablaze and it is like the Day of Judgement—Ghazi, where are you? Look, the accursed\nShimr has snatched the veils. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Chadar chini, dur lay liye ab-e zulmana dhawo Baba se milawo Neze ke tale betth-e\nke roti hai sakina. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: The chadar was snatched and the earrings taken—now they rush upon us cruelly. Take me to Baba Beneath the spear,\nSakina sits and weeps. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed

arabic text: Paband-e rasan bibiya bazar-e khule sar Har-e mor-e pe pathar Masum-e yatimo ka\nbaha. Surkh-e pasina. Barbad-e huwi mai\nAbad-e huwi karbobala, ujra madina. Barbad-e huwi mai
english translation text: The ladies are bound in ropes and taken bareheaded through the marketplaces—stones at every turn The innocent orphans'\nred sweat flows. I have been destroyed\nKarbala was made eternal, Madina was ruined; I have been destroyed
